source: 2013/TSB Vol 13 No 06 Smart Tech Conversion Kit.pdf
title: Smart Tech ATF Conversion Kit
lead: MOC has created a kit (Part No. 94815) to upgrade an existing Standard ATF Machine (Part No. 94500) into a new Smart Tech™ ATF Machine (Part No. 94800). It is stocked and available for purchase.
body: Each kit includes a Step-by-Step instruction guide.
